Definition: Shammai, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Three men answer to the name Shammai, and the genealogies keep them straight. One is the son of Onam, whose sons were Nadab and Abishur, another is the son of Rekem and the father of Maon, and the third is a son of Ezra named beside Miriam and Ishbah.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that three men sharing one name are still three men to God, and the genealogies are His way of saying so.
